readings: For films with replacement_cost > 20.99, report each rating’s average rental_duration and average of each film’s rental_rate / replacement_cost, ignoring missing values. Then report one summary row containing the unrounded average of the per-rating durations followed by the unrounded average of the per-rating ratios. Weight each rating equally in the summary row.

For films with replacement_cost >= 20.99, report each rating’s average rental_duration and average of each film’s rental_rate / replacement_cost, ignoring missing values. Then report one summary row containing the unrounded average of the per-rating durations followed by the unrounded average of the per-rating ratios. Weight each rating equally in the summary row.
queries:
WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(rental_duration) AS avg_rental_duration,
    AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(replacement_cost, 0)) AS avg_rate_to_cost
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
),
report AS (
  SELECT rating, avg_rental_duration, avg_rate_to_cost, 0 AS sort_order
  FROM rating_averages
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'Summary',
    AVG(avg_rental_duration),
    AVG(avg_rate_to_cost),
    1
  FROM rating_averages
)
SELECT rating, avg_rental_duration, avg_rate_to_cost
FROM report
ORDER BY sort_order, rating;

WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(rental_duration) AS avg_rental_duration,
    AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(replacement_cost, 0)) AS avg_rate_to_cost
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT rating, avg_rental_duration, avg_rate_to_cost
FROM (
  SELECT rating, avg_rental_duration, avg_rate_to_cost, 0 AS row_order
  FROM rating_averages
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Summary', AVG(avg_rental_duration), AVG(avg_rate_to_cost), 1
  FROM rating_averages
)
ORDER BY row_order, rating
